0022600001.text: Both the Detroit Pistons and Boston Celtics open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, which Detroit hosts. Boston has three players listed as day-to-day with rest as the reason and game-time decisions: Neemias Queta, Payton Pritchard and Sam Hauser, while Detroit has no players on the absence list. The teams' 2025-26 season series ended with the Pistons winning 3-1, and their most recent meeting was a 104-103 Detroit win in Detroit on January 19, 2026, while ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Pistons a 50% chance to win.
